commits.author: Omar Tabsh
commits.message:
Implement Security Reports service (Service 6)

Six report endpoints computed from live data fetched through the other
services' APIs using the caller's token. Includes end-to-end tests running
the threat, logging and reports services together over HTTP.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: Omar Tabsh
commits.message:
Implement Security Audit Logging service (Service 5)

POST /logs for administrators and trusted services, retrieval, search by
user/date/action/severity/service, logs by user and admin-only deletion.
Logs are immutable: no update route and a database trigger blocks UPDATE.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: Omar Tabsh
commits.message:
Implement Threat Intelligence service (Service 4)

POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /threats, GET /threats/{id} and GET /threats/search with
IP, domain and file hash validation, duplicate indicator rejection (409),
role-based access and automatic audit logging of changes and violations.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: Omar Tabsh
commits.message:
Add shared config, JWT authentication, response format and audit client

Shared building blocks for all services: role constants, JWT verification
with require_roles(), the agreed audit event vocabulary, the audit client
that sends events to POST /logs with the inter-service key, and JSON error
handling.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
